# Exploring ERA
## Downloading the data

This section retrieves the most recent version of the ERA.Compiled comparisons table from the ERA S3 bucket, saves it locally, and loads it for use.

```{r pre-load era compiled, echo=T, message=F}
# Set S3 path and initialize
s3 <- s3fs::S3FileSystem$new(anonymous = TRUE)
era_s3 <- "s3://digital-atlas/era"
bundle_dir <- file.path(era_s3, "data", "packaged")

# Get the latest bundle
all_files <- s3$dir_ls(bundle_dir)
latest_bundle <- tail(sort(grep("era_agronomy_bundle.*\\.tar\\.gz$", all_files, value = TRUE)), 1)

# Define download and extraction paths
dl_dir <- "downloaded_data"
dir.create(dl_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
bundle_local <- file.path(dl_dir, basename(latest_bundle))
extract_dir <- file.path(dl_dir, tools::file_path_sans_ext(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(latest_bundle))))

# Download and extract
if (!file.exists(bundle_local)) {
  s3$file_download(latest_bundle, bundle_local, overwrite = TRUE)
}
if (!dir.exists(extract_dir)) {
  dir.create(extract_dir)
  utils::untar(bundle_local, exdir = extract_dir)
}

# Locate files
json_agronomic <- list.files(extract_dir, pattern = "^agronomic_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
json_master <- list.files(extract_dir, pattern = "^era_master_codes.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
parquet_file <- list.files(extract_dir, pattern = "^era_compiled.*\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)

# Load into variables
ERA_Compiled <- arrow::read_parquet(parquet_file)
agronomic_metadata <- fromJSON(json_agronomic)
mastercodes <- fromJSON(json_master)
```


We currently have 41 papers in ERA that explicitly report Land Equivalent Ratio (LER) as an outcome. However, LER can also be calculated from studies that report yield data for both crops under intercrop and monocrop conditions.
For a two-crop intercrop:
\[
LER = \frac{Y_{1,IC}}{Y_{1,SC}} + \frac{Y_{2,IC}}{Y_{2,SC}}
\]where \(Y_{IC}\) is the yield under intercropping and \(Y_{SC}\) is the yield of the same crop when grown as a sole crop.
This means the evidence base can be expanded beyond the 41 studies that report LER directly, provided the necessary yield data are available.
## Calculating LER from yield data

### Intercropping practice codes

Intercropping codes are taken from `mastercodes$prac` (Practice = "Intercropping"). `b59` ("Intercropping or Rotation") is excluded because it does not distinguish intercropping from rotation.

```{r intercrop codes, echo=T, message=F}
prac <- as.data.table(mastercodes$prac)
ic_codes <- prac[Practice == "Intercropping", Code]
prac[Code %in% ic_codes, .(Code, Practice, Subpractice)]
```

### Matching intercrop components to their monocrops

ERA stores **pairwise comparisons** (control arm vs treatment arm), and two features of that structure mean neither the comparison rows alone nor the treatments alone are enough:

- An intercrop component is often compared only with a *base* monocrop. In Bado et al. 2021 (AC0168), the intercrop millet with fertiliser F1 (`MC PM F1`) is only compared with unfertilised sole millet (`MM F0`), so `plist` mixes intercropping with fertiliser. The matching sole crop (`MM F1`) appears only as the treatment arm of a different comparison.
- Some papers reuse one control ID for several sole crops. In Tsubo et al. 2003 (LM0141), sole maize at three densities (7.9, 9.0, 10.3 t/ha) all have control ID `T0`, so only the comparison row says which sole yield belongs to which intercrop density.

The matching therefore works per intercrop component (`r_scripts/ler_matching.R`):

1. **Treatments.** Every arm of every yield row becomes a treatment record: paper × site × year × crop × treatment ID → yield(s), label and practice codes (`C1–C13` / `T1–T13`).
   - A treatment is an intercrop if its practice codes include an intercropping code, or its label is shared with another crop and is not labelled sole.
   - Arms whose label contradicts their practice codes (e.g. labelled `kale mono` but coded as intercrop) are excluded as `label_code_conflict`.
   - A control whose label is identical to an intercrop component label of the same crop (e.g. `MZ- 2:2 rows-maize`) is an intercrop component, not a sole crop, and is never used as a denominator.
   - A 0 recorded alongside non-zero yields for the same treatment is treated as a placeholder. Negative yields (digitising artefacts) are rejected.
   - Yield rows whose **raw** ERA outcome is in LER units (`Crop Yield..t/ha..LER` in `Data.Out`) are not yields. The compiled table codes them as Outcode 101, so they are identified from the raw outcome and kept separately as reported LER.
2. **Candidate monocrops.** These are sole treatments of the same crop in the same paper, site and year, with a compatible variety. The same experimental context is identified by:
   - **label modifiers** that distinguish the candidate monocrops from each other (F0–F3, low/high density, sprayed/unsprayed, Soybean-10/20/30). These must all appear in the intercrop label.
   - otherwise, **experimental-factor practice codes**: codes that vary between treatments of that crop (e.g. fertiliser, Ziziphus) must match. Codes that are constant within each arm (e.g. the intercrop is fertilised for the cereal and the sole legume is not) are design-level management. They are allowed and flagged `design_management_differs`.
3. **Yields.** If ERA has a direct comparison row between the intercrop component and the matched monocrop, the yields paired in that row are used. Otherwise the monocrop yield is looked up from the treatment table.
4. **Ambiguity is flagged, not guessed.** A component is rejected if it has more than one matching monocrop (`multiple_matching_monocrops`), more than one distinct intercrop/monocrop yield pair (`multiple_yield_pairs`), several yields for the same intercrop treatment (`multiple_intercrop_yields`), no monocrop (`no_matching_monocrop`), or only monocrops from a different treatment (`treatment_mismatch`).

LER for one system = Σ pLER = Σ (intercrop yield / monocrop yield) over its component crops, calculated at full precision. A system gets an LER only if every component crop (from the system ID, ignoring non-crop tags such as `Zizi`) has exactly one valid pLER. Accepted systems where labels matched but ERA's practice codes for a factor disagree are flagged `factor_codes_differ_label_match`.

```{r ler functions, echo=T, message=F}
source("r_scripts/ler_matching.R")
ERA_dt <- as.data.table(ERA_Compiled)

# Papers with an intercrop arm anywhere in their yield data
yld <- ERA_dt[Outcode == "101"]
arm_cols <- c(paste0("C", 1:13), paste0("T", 1:13))
ic_papers <- unique(yld[Reduce(`|`, lapply(arm_cols, function(k) get(k) %in% ic_codes)), Code])

# Yield rows whose raw ERA outcome is in LER units ("Crop Yield..t/ha..LER", e.g. Kermah et al.
# Table 7 reported LERs, Falconnier et al. Table 4 pLERs) are not yields: excluded here and kept
# separately as reported LER / validation data
ler_coded_idx <- ler_coded_index(ERA_dt, agronomic_metadata$Data.Out)
reported_ler_raw <- as.data.table(agronomic_metadata$Data.Out)[grepl("[.][.]LER$", Out.Code.Joined),
  .(Code = B.Code, Site.ID, Time, Crop = P.Product, T.Name, IN.Level.Name, LER = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ED.Mean.T)),
    Out.Code.Joined, DataLoc = ED.Data.Loc)]

ler_run <- calc_ler_systems(ERA_dt, ic_papers, exclude_index = ler_coded_idx)

reported <- ERA_dt[grepl("103", Outcode), .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys = sys_of(T.Descrip), LER_reported = MeanT)]
reported <- reported[, .(LER_reported = paste(unique(round(LER_reported, 2)), collapse = "/")),
                     by = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)]
ler_systems <- merge(ler_run$systems, reported, by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "sys"), all.x = TRUE)

calc_ler <- function(codes) ler_systems[Code %in% codes]
```

### Worked examples

LM0141 (Tsubo et al. 2003, maize–bean) also reports LER directly (Outcode `103`), so the calculated values can be checked against the paper's own. Bado et al. 2021 (AC0168) shows the fertiliser (F0–F3) × Ziziphus design, where each intercrop is matched to the monocrop with the same fertiliser level and tree condition.

```{r ler worked example, echo=T, message=F}
knitr::kable(calc_ler("LM0141")[, .(M.Year, sys, status, pLER, LER = round(LER, 3), LER_reported)])
knitr::kable(calc_ler("AC0168")[M.Year == "2016", .(M.Year, sys, status, pLER, LER = round(LER, 3), qc_flag)])
```

## Papers cited in Adam et al. that are in ERA

The 90-reference list of Adam et al. was matched to ERA on first-author surname + year (±1 year for print/online differences), and ambiguous hits were resolved by journal/DOI. 37 ERA codes (31 references) match. Notable non-matches by journal/DOI: Bouras 2023 (ERA has a 2022 Agronomy paper), Mogale 2022, Gitari 2018/2019, Hulugalle 1988, Mbah 2009/2012, Nyawade 2019/2020 (ERA has different Nyawade papers).


## Adding calculated LER rows to the LER data

New rows are built in the same format as the reported ERA LER rows (Outcode `103`): `Units = "LER"`, `MeanC = 1` (sole crops), `MeanT` = LER at full precision, `yi = log(MeanT/MeanC)`, `pc = 100*(MeanT/MeanC - 1)`, `Product` = component crops joined with `-`, and `Out.SubInd = "Land Equivalent Ratio"`. All other site and study fields are copied from the intercrop component's ERA row. `TID` holds the intercrop treatment IDs, and `CID` / `C.Descrip` hold the monocrop treatments used. Three columns are added:

- `LER.Source`, in four categories:
  - **A. `calculated_automatic`:** calculated from ERA yields, and all matching information exists in ERA.
  - **B. `calculated_manual_qc`:** calculated from ERA yields, but ERA has lost or misassigned information needed to pair them, and the original publication resolves it. Every component and its source is in `qc_inputs/manual_qc_components.csv`, and `LER.QC` names the publication-sourced values.
  - **C. `reported`:** LER reported directly (ERA Outcode 103). **`reported_raw`:** LER reported by the paper and kept in the raw extraction but dropped from the compiled table (see "Reported LER recovered from the raw extraction"). `reported_pLER_sum` is the sum of partial LERs reported by the paper (Falconnier et al. 2016), not recalculated from yields. Raw ERA LER-coded records entered under the yield outcome (Kermah et al. 2017, Table 7) are kept separately in `outputs/qc/reported_LER_raw_coded.csv` as validation data.
  - **D. Unresolved:** not in the LER data; listed with reasons in `outputs/qc/LER_audit_systems.csv`.
- `pLER`: the partial LERs that were summed, rounded to 3 decimals for display only.
- `LER.QC`: QC flags on accepted systems.

The full audit trail (intercrop and monocrop treatment IDs, labels, yields and practice codes, match basis and rejection reasons) is in `outputs/qc/LER_audit_components.csv` and `outputs/qc/LER_audit_systems.csv`.

Included: systems with status `OK` from papers with African sites that do **not** already report LER in ERA. Excluded:

- Watanabe 2019 (JO0076): natural fallow + pearl millet is not an intercrop.
- van Asten 2011 (NN0311): coffee–banana perennial system.

NM0030 (Songa 2007) is kept but needs QC: its maize–millet/sorghum systems give LERs of 0.06–0.9 (maize intercrop yield of 0).

Falconnier et al. 2016 (DK0064, Adam ID DAR33) reports only partial LERs (Table 4). ERA captured these as Outcode `101` with `Units = Mg/ha` and no `MeanC`, which is a coding error: they are pLERs, not yields. LER = cereal grain pLER + cowpea grain pLER per intercropping pattern, exactly as Adam did. Cowpea **fodder** pLERs are excluded, so these are grain LERs.

```{r ler new rows, echo=T, message=F}
product_subtype <- function(crops) {
  st <- unique(ERA_dt[Product.Simple %in% crops, .(Product.Simple, Product.Subtype)])
  paste(sort(unique(st$Product.Subtype)), collapse = "-")
}

ler_exclude <- c("JO0076",   # Watanabe 2019: natural fallow + pearl millet, not an intercrop
                 "NN0311")   # van Asten 2011: coffee-banana perennial system
iso_by_paper <- rbind(unique(ERA_dt[, .(Code, iso = ISO.3166.1.alpha.3)]),
                      unique(as.data.table(agronomic_metadata$Data.Out)[!B.Code %in% ERA_dt$Code, .(Code = B.Code, iso = ISO.3166.1.alpha.3)]))
africa_papers <- iso_by_paper[!is.na(iso), .(africa = all(iso %in% world$adm0_a3)), by = Code][africa == TRUE, Code]

# Reported LER in the raw extraction that the compiled table dropped (LER recorded as an outcome,
# or under the yield outcome with "LER" in Species/Item/Group). Only systems with ONE value are
# taken as a reported LER; systems with several values (often unlabelled partial LERs, one per
# crop) are ambiguous and left for QC. Papers already covered by compiled Outcode 103 or by the
# reported-pLER route (Falconnier) are not duplicated.
raw_ler <- reported_ler_from_raw(agronomic_metadata$Data.Out, agronomic_metadata$Out.Out)
compiled_103 <- unique(ERA_dt[grepl("103", Outcode), Code])
raw_rep <- raw_ler$reported[Code %in% africa_papers & !Code %in% compiled_103 & !Code %in% ler_exclude & Code != "DK0064"]
raw_rep[, paper_has_multi := any(n_values_system > 1), by = Code]
raw_ler_ambiguous <- raw_rep[n_values_system > 1]
raw_rep <- raw_rep[n_values_system == 1]

# papers that report LER (compiled or raw) are not recalculated from yields
already_reported <- unique(c(compiled_103, raw_rep$Code))

in_scope <- function(dt) dt[Code %in% africa_papers & !Code %in% already_reported & !Code %in% ler_exclude]
ler_keep <- in_scope(ler_systems)[status == "OK"]
ler_comp <- in_scope(ler_run$components)[ler_keep[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)], on = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)]

# 1. LER from sole + intercrop yields: one row per system, metadata from the intercrop component's ERA row
ler_new_yield <- ler_comp[, {
  tmpl <- ERA_dt[Index == as.numeric(sub(",.*$", "", ic_rows[1]))][1]
  crops <- sort(unique(Crop))
  tmpl[, `:=`(
    Index = NA, Outcode = "103", Units = "LER",
    T.Descrip = .BY$sys_, TID = paste(ic_id, collapse = "-"),
    C.Descrip = paste(mono_label, collapse = " | "), CID = paste(mono_id, collapse = "-"),
    Product = paste(crops, collapse = "-"), Product.Simple = paste(crops, collapse = "-"),
    Product.Subtype = product_subtype(crops),
    Out.SubInd = "Land Equivalent Ratio", DataLoc = "calculated",
    MeanT.Error = NA, MeanC.Error = NA, Mean.Error.Type = NA,
    MeanC = 1, MeanT = sum(pLER)
  )]
  tmpl[, `:=`(yi = log(MeanT), pc = 100 * (MeanT - 1))]
  tmpl[, `:=`(LER.Source = "calculated_automatic",
              pLER = paste0(Crop, "=", sprintf("%.3f", pLER), collapse = "; "))]
  tmpl
}, by = .(Code_ = Code, Site_ = Site.ID, Year_ = M.Year, sys_ = sys)]
ler_new_yield[, c("Code_", "Site_", "Year_", "sys_") := NULL]
ler_new_yield <- merge(ler_new_yield, ler_keep[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, T.Descrip = sys, LER.QC = qc_flag)],
                       by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "T.Descrip"), all.x = TRUE)

# 2. Falconnier 2016 (DK0064): sum grain pLERs captured as Outcode 101
falc <- ERA_dt[Code == "DK0064" & Outcode == "101"]
falc <- falc[grepl("-", Product.Simple) & is.na(MeanC) & !grepl("fodder", T.Descrip, ignore.case = TRUE)]
ler_new_pler <- falc[, {
  tmpl <- copy(.SD[1])
  crops <- sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(Product.Simple, "-"))))
  tmpl[, `:=`(Index = NA, Outcode = "103", Units = "LER", T.Descrip = .BY$T.Descrip_,
              Product = paste(crops, collapse = "-"), Product.Simple = paste(crops, collapse = "-"),
              Product.Subtype = product_subtype(crops),
              Out.SubInd = "Land Equivalent Ratio", DataLoc = "calculated",
              MeanT.Error = NA, MeanC.Error = NA, Mean.Error.Type = NA,
              MeanC = 1, MeanT = sum(.SD$MeanT))]
  tmpl[, `:=`(yi = log(MeanT), pc = 100 * (MeanT - 1), LER.Source = "reported_pLER_sum",
              pLER = paste(.SD$MeanT, collapse = " + "), LER.QC = NA_character_)]
  tmpl
}, by = .(T.Descrip_ = T.Descrip)][, T.Descrip_ := NULL]

# 3. Calculated with manual publication QC: ERA holds the yields but has lost or misassigned
# information needed to pair them; the original publication resolves it. Every component value
# and its source is listed in qc_inputs/manual_qc_components.csv (confirmed rows only).
mqc <- fread("qc_inputs/manual_qc_components.csv", colClasses = list(character = c("M.Year", "Site.ID")))[status == "confirmed"]
mqc <- mqc[!paper %in% already_reported]   # a paper that reports LER is not recalculated
mqc_sys <- mqc[, {
  m <- merge(.SD[role == "intercrop", .(crop, ic_y = value)], .SD[role == "sole", .(crop, mono_y = value)], by = "crop")
  ok <- nrow(m) >= 2 && nrow(m) == uniqueN(.SD$crop) && all(m$mono_y > 0) && all(m$ic_y >= 0)
  .(LER = if (ok) sum(m$ic_y / m$mono_y) else NA_real_,
    pLER = paste0(m$crop, "=", sprintf("%.3f", m$ic_y / m$mono_y), collapse = "; "),
    crops = paste(sort(m$crop), collapse = "-"),
    publication_values = paste(unique(paste(crop, role)[value_source == "publication"]), collapse = "; "),
    sources = paste(paste0(crop, " ", role, ": ", source_ref), collapse = " | "))
}, by = .(Code_ = paper, Site_ = Site.ID, Year_ = M.Year, sys_ = system)]
if (nrow(mqc_sys) == 0) mqc_sys <- data.table(Code_ = character(), Site_ = character(), Year_ = character(), sys_ = character(),
                                              LER = numeric(), pLER = character(), crops = character(),
                                              publication_values = character(), sources = character())
stopifnot(mqc_sys[, all(!is.na(LER))])

# a manual-QC system supersedes any automatic row for the same system
ler_new_yield <- ler_new_yield[!paste(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, T.Descrip) %in% mqc_sys[, paste(Code_, Site_, Year_, sys_)]]
ler_new_manual <- if (nrow(mqc_sys) == 0) data.table() else mqc_sys[, {
  tmpl <- copy(ERA_dt[Code == Code_ & Site.ID == Site_ & Outcode == "101"][1])
  cr <- strsplit(crops, "-")[[1]]
  tmpl[, `:=`(Index = NA, Outcode = "103", Units = "LER", M.Year = Year_, T.Descrip = sys_,
              TID = NA, CID = NA, C.Descrip = NA, Variety = NA,
              Product = crops, Product.Simple = crops, Product.Subtype = product_subtype(cr),
              Out.SubInd = "Land Equivalent Ratio", DataLoc = "calculated",
              MeanT.Error = NA, MeanC.Error = NA, Mean.Error.Type = NA,
              MeanC = 1, MeanT = LER)]
  tmpl[, `:=`(yi = log(MeanT), pc = 100 * (MeanT - 1), LER.Source = "calculated_manual_qc", pLER = pLER,
              LER.QC = paste0("manual_publication_qc: ", publication_values))]
  tmpl
}, by = .(Code_, Site_, Year_, sys_)]
if (nrow(ler_new_manual)) ler_new_manual[, c("Code_", "Site_", "Year_", "sys_") := NULL]

# 4. Reported LER from the raw extraction (category C): one row per single-valued system,
# metadata from a compiled row of the same paper and site where one exists
ler_new_raw <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(raw_rep)), function(i) {
  r <- raw_rep[i]
  tmpl <- ERA_dt[Code == r$Code & Site.ID == r$Site.ID][1]
  if (is.na(tmpl$Code)) tmpl <- ERA_dt[Code == r$Code][1]
  tmpl <- if (is.na(tmpl$Code)) data.table(Code = r$Code) else copy(tmpl)
  prod <- gsub('..', '-', r$Product, fixed = TRUE)
  qc <- c(if (!is.na(r$LER.Group) && nzchar(r$LER.Group)) paste0('LER basis: ', r$LER.Group),
          if (r$paper_has_multi) 'paper also has multi-valued LER systems (check this is a total, not a partial LER)')
  tmpl[, `:=`(Index = NA, Outcode = '103', Out.SubInd = 'Land Equivalent Ratio', Units = 'LER',
              Site.ID = r$Site.ID, M.Year = r$M.Year,
              T.Descrip = if (!is.na(r$IN.Level.Name)) r$IN.Level.Name else r$T.Name,
              TID = NA, CID = NA, C.Descrip = NA, Product = prod, Product.Simple = prod, DataLoc = r$DataLoc,
              MeanT.Error = NA, MeanC.Error = NA, Mean.Error.Type = NA,
              MeanC = 1, MeanT = r$LER, yi = log(r$LER), pc = 100 * (r$LER - 1),
              LER.Source = 'reported_raw', pLER = NA_character_,
              LER.QC = if (length(qc)) paste(qc, collapse = '; ') else NA_character_)]
  tmpl
}), fill = TRUE)

# 5. Append to the LER data
LER_all <- rbindlist(list(
  ERA_dt[grepl("103", Outcode)][, `:=`(LER.Source = "reported", pLER = NA_character_, LER.QC = NA_character_)],
  ler_new_raw,
  ler_new_yield,
  ler_new_manual,
  ler_new_pler
), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

LER_all[, .(rows = .N, papers = uniqueN(Code)), by = LER.Source]

knitr::kable(rbind(ler_new_yield, ler_new_manual, ler_new_pler, fill = TRUE)[, .(Code, Author, Date, Country, M.Year, T.Descrip, Product, pLER, LER = round(MeanT, 3), LER.Source, LER.QC)])
```

### Reported LER recovered from the raw extraction

Some extractors did not record LER under the LER outcome that becomes Outcode 103. They entered it either as a "Land Equivalent Ratio" outcome without a control comparison, or under Crop Yield with `LER` in Species/Item/Group (e.g. Kermah et al. 2017, Table 7). The compiled table drops both, but the raw extraction (`Data.Out`, `Out.Out`) keeps them. These papers now count as **reporting** LER (`LER.Source = reported_raw`), so they are not recalculated from yields.

- Only systems with one LER value are used.
- Systems with several values are often unlabelled partial LERs, one per crop. They are left out and listed in `outputs/qc/LER_raw_ambiguous.csv`.

For papers where a yield-based calculation was also possible, the two are compared below as a check.

```{r reported raw ler, echo=T, message=F}
knitr::kable(data.table(
  measure = c("papers with reported LER only in the raw extraction", "reported LER rows added",
              "papers with only ambiguous (multi-valued) raw LER", "papers with compiled LER (Outcode 103)"),
  n = c(uniqueN(raw_rep$Code), nrow(raw_rep),
        length(setdiff(unique(raw_ler_ambiguous$Code), raw_rep$Code)), length(intersect(compiled_103, africa_papers)))))

# calculated (from yields) vs reported, matched on paper x site x year x system
norm_sys <- function(s) norm_txt(gsub("..", "***", s, fixed = TRUE))
calc_vs_rep <- merge(
  ler_systems[status == "OK" & Code %in% raw_rep$Code, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, k = norm_sys(sys), sys, LER_calculated = LER)],
  raw_rep[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, k = norm_sys(fifelse(!is.na(IN.Level.Name), IN.Level.Name, T.Name)), LER_reported = LER, DataLoc)],
  by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "k"))
calc_vs_rep[, diff := LER_calculated - LER_reported]
knitr::kable(calc_vs_rep[, .(systems = .N, mean_abs_diff = round(mean(abs(diff)), 3), max_abs_diff = round(max(abs(diff)), 3),
                             within_0.05 = sum(abs(diff) <= 0.05)), by = Code][order(-max_abs_diff)])
```

### Validation of the calculated rows

Every calculated-yield LER is checked against its audit trail: each component has an intercrop yield and exactly one monocrop reference, pLER is reproduced from those yields, `MeanT` equals the sum of the unrounded pLERs, the component crops match the system, and no component was matched across paper, site or year.

```{r ler validation, echo=T, message=F}
chk <- merge(ler_comp, ler_new_yield[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys = T.Descrip, MeanT, Product)],
             by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "sys"))
mono_tr <- merge(chk[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, Crop, id = mono_id)], ler_run$treatments,
                 by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "Crop", "id"))
checks <- c(
  every_component_has_intercrop_yield = chk[, all(!is.na(ic_y) & !is.na(ic_id))],
  every_component_has_one_monocrop    = chk[, all(!is.na(mono_id) & !is.na(mono_y) & is.na(reason))],
  one_component_per_crop              = chk[, .N, by = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys, Crop)][, all(N == 1)],
  pLER_reproduced_from_yields         = chk[, isTRUE(all.equal(pLER, ic_y / mono_y))],
  MeanT_equals_sum_of_unrounded_pLER  = chk[, .(s = sum(pLER), m = MeanT[1]), by = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)][, isTRUE(all.equal(s, m))],
  products_match_components           = chk[, .(p = paste(sort(unique(Crop)), collapse = "-"), q = Product[1]), by = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)][, all(p == q)],
  monocrops_found_in_same_site_year   = nrow(mono_tr) == nrow(chk),
  monocrop_is_not_an_intercrop        = all(!mono_tr$is_ic),
  no_rows_without_audit               = nrow(ler_new_yield) == chk[, uniqueN(paste(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys))]
)
knitr::kable(data.table(check = names(checks), passed = checks))
stopifnot(all(checks))
```

### QC: previous vs corrected calculation

The previous calculation (`outputs/qc/LER_calculated_v1_baseline.csv`, before the matching was corrected) is compared with the corrected one, matched on paper × site × year × system ID.

```{r ler qc compare, echo=T, message=F}
old <- fread("outputs/qc/LER_calculated_v1_baseline.csv",
             colClasses = list(character = c("M.Year", "Site.ID", "T.Descrip")))[LER.Source == "calculated_yield",
             .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys = T.Descrip, LER_old = MeanT, pLER_old = pLER)]
new <- rbind(ler_new_yield, ler_new_manual, fill = TRUE)[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys = T.Descrip, LER_new = MeanT, pLER_new = pLER, LER.Source, LER.QC)]
qc <- merge(old, new, by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "sys"), all = TRUE)
qc <- merge(qc, ler_systems[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys, new_status = status)],
            by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "sys"), all.x = TRUE)
qc[, change := fcase(
  !is.na(LER_old) & !is.na(LER_new) & abs(LER_old - LER_new) <= 0.005, "unchanged",
  !is.na(LER_old) & !is.na(LER_new),                                   "value_changed",
  is.na(LER_old)  & !is.na(LER_new),                                   "recovered",
  !is.na(LER_old) & is.na(LER_new),                                    "removed")]

flagged <- in_scope(ler_systems)[status != "OK" & n_crops >= 2]
knitr::kable(data.table(
  measure = c("calculated LER rows before", "calculated LER rows after", "unchanged", "LER value changed",
              "newly recovered", "removed (previous match invalid or now ambiguous)",
              "candidate systems flagged ambiguous / unmatchable", "papers affected"),
  n = c(qc[!is.na(LER_old), .N], qc[!is.na(LER_new), .N], qc[change == "unchanged", .N],
        qc[change == "value_changed", .N], qc[change == "recovered", .N], qc[change == "removed", .N],
        nrow(flagged), qc[change != "unchanged", uniqueN(Code)])
))

qc_by_paper <- qc[, .(rows_before = sum(!is.na(LER_old)), rows_after = sum(!is.na(LER_new)),
                      unchanged = sum(change == "unchanged"), value_changed = sum(change == "value_changed"),
                      recovered = sum(change == "recovered"), removed = sum(change == "removed"),
                      removal_reasons = paste(unique(na.omit(new_status[change == "removed"])), collapse = "; ")),
                  by = Code]
qc_by_paper <- merge(unique(ERA_dt[, .(Code, Author, Date)]), qc_by_paper, by = "Code")[order(-(recovered + removed + value_changed))]
knitr::kable(qc_by_paper)

# Flagged candidate systems by reason (for manual QC)
knitr::kable(flagged[, .(systems = .N, papers = uniqueN(Code)), by = .(reason = status)][order(-systems)])
```

## Updated LER evidence base

Papers with LER now = papers reporting LER directly + papers where LER was calculated.

```{r ler updated map, echo=T, message=F}
LER_map <- copy(LER_all)
LER_map[, `:=`(Latitude = as.numeric(Latitude), Longitude = as.numeric(Longitude))]
LER_map[, Source := ifelse(LER.Source == "reported", "Reported", "Calculated")]

paper_counts_all <- LER_map[, .(N_Papers = uniqueN(Code)), by = Country]

map_data_all <- world %>%
  dplyr::select(admin, geometry) %>%
  rename(Country = admin) %>%
  left_join(paper_counts_all, by = "Country")

sites_all <- unique(LER_map[!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude), .(Code, Latitude, Longitude, Source)])

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = map_data_all, aes(fill = N_Papers), color = "white") +
  geom_point(data = sites_all, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, shape = Source),
             color = "black", fill = "white", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +

    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

  ) +

  coord_sf(xlim = c(-20, 55), ylim = c(-35, 38), expand = FALSE)
```

### Save the LER data

```{r save ler, echo=T, message=F}
out_dir <- "outputs"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
data.table::fwrite(LER_all, file.path(out_dir, "LER_all.csv"))                                    # reported + calculated
data.table::fwrite(LER_all[LER.Source != "reported"], file.path(out_dir, "LER_calculated_new.csv")) # new rows only

# QC / audit tables (in-scope papers: African, not already reporting LER)
qc_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "qc")
dir.create(qc_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
audit_comp <- in_scope(ler_run$components)[, .(
  Code, Site.ID, M.Year, system_id = sys, crop = Crop,
  intercrop_id = ic_id, intercrop_label = ic_label, intercrop_codes = ic_codes, intercrop_yield = ic_y,
  intercrop_yields_all = ic_yields_all, intercrop_era_rows = ic_rows,
  monocrop_id = mono_id, monocrop_label = mono_label, monocrop_codes = mono_codes, monocrop_yield = mono_y,
  pLER, match_basis, factor_codes_differ = factor_diff, design_codes_differ = design_diff,
  reason, candidates)]
audit_sys <- in_scope(ler_systems)[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, system_id = sys, crops, n_crops, n_expected,
                                       status, pLER, LER, qc_flag, intercrop_ids = ic_ids, monocrop_ids = mono_ids, LER_reported)]
data.table::fwrite(audit_comp, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_audit_components.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(audit_sys, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_audit_systems.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(qc, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_qc_old_vs_new.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(qc_by_paper, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_qc_by_paper.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(ler_run$zero_log[Code %in% unique(audit_comp$Code)], file.path(qc_dir, "LER_zero_placeholders_dropped.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(reported_ler_raw, file.path(qc_dir, "reported_LER_raw_coded.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(raw_ler_ambiguous, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_raw_ambiguous.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(raw_ler$partial_log, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_raw_partial_excluded.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(calc_vs_rep, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_calculated_vs_reported_raw.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(mqc_sys[, .(Code = Code_, Site.ID = Site_, M.Year = Year_, system_id = sys_, crops, pLER, LER, publication_values, sources)],
                   file.path(qc_dir, "LER_audit_manual_qc.csv"))
```

### Manual QC review files

One review file per purpose, for checking the calculated LERs paper by paper:

- **Paper checklist** (`outputs/qc/LER_paper_checklist.csv`): one row per paper, with the number of LERs by category and blank QC columns.
- **System review** (`outputs/qc/LER_system_review.csv`): one row per candidate intercrop system. It shows every component's intercrop and monocrop treatment, label and yield, the pLERs, the category (A automatic / B manual QC / D unresolved), the status or reason, and QC flags, with blank decision columns.

Both are also written to `outputs/qc/LER_QC_workbook.xlsx` (sheets `checklist` and `systems`).

```{r qc review files, echo=T, message=F}
papers_meta <- unique(ERA_dt[, .(Code, Author, Date, DOI, Country)])[, .SD[1], by = Code]

# components collapsed to one line per system
comp_txt <- in_scope(ler_run$components)[, .(
  components = paste0(Crop, ": IC '", ic_label, "' = ", signif(ic_y, 4), " / sole '", mono_label, "' = ", signif(mono_y, 4),
                      fifelse(is.na(reason), "", paste0(" [", reason, "]")), collapse = "  ||  ")
), by = .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)]

auto_sys <- in_scope(ler_systems)[n_crops >= 2]
auto_sys <- merge(auto_sys, comp_txt, by = c("Code", "Site.ID", "M.Year", "sys"), all.x = TRUE)
auto_sys[, category := fifelse(status == "OK", "A_calculated_automatic", "D_unresolved")]
manual_sys <- mqc_sys[, .(Code = Code_, Site.ID = Site_, M.Year = Year_, sys = sys_, crops, pLER, LER,
                          status = "OK", qc_flag = paste0("manual_publication_qc: ", publication_values),
                          components = sources, category = "B_calculated_manual_qc")]
# a manual-QC system supersedes the automatic attempt at the same system
auto_sys <- auto_sys[!paste(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys) %in% manual_sys[, paste(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys)]]

review <- rbind(auto_sys[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys, crops, category, status, LER, pLER, qc_flag, components, LER_reported)],
                manual_sys,
                raw_rep[, .(Code, Site.ID, M.Year, sys = fifelse(!is.na(IN.Level.Name), IN.Level.Name, T.Name), crops = Product,
                            category = 'C_reported_raw', status = 'reported', LER,
                            qc_flag = fifelse(paper_has_multi, 'paper also has multi-valued LER systems', NA_character_),
                            components = paste0('reported in ', DataLoc, fifelse(is.na(LER.Group), '', paste0(' (', LER.Group, ')'))))],
                fill = TRUE)
review <- merge(papers_meta, review, by = "Code", all.y = TRUE)
review[, `:=`(qc_decision = "", qc_corrected_LER = "", qc_notes = "", qc_by = "", qc_date = "")]
setorder(review, Code, Site.ID, M.Year, category, sys)

checklist <- review[, .(
  n_A_automatic   = sum(category == "A_calculated_automatic"),
  n_B_manual_qc   = sum(category == "B_calculated_manual_qc"),
  n_D_unresolved  = sum(category == "D_unresolved"),
  n_C_reported_raw = sum(category == 'C_reported_raw'),
  n_flagged       = sum(!is.na(qc_flag) & category != "D_unresolved"),
  LER_min         = suppressWarnings(round(min(LER, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
  LER_max         = suppressWarnings(round(max(LER, na.rm = TRUE), 3)),
  unresolved_reasons = paste(unique(status[category == "D_unresolved"]), collapse = "; ")
), by = .(Code, Author, Date, DOI, Country)]
checklist[!is.finite(LER_min), `:=`(LER_min = NA, LER_max = NA)]
checklist <- checklist[n_A_automatic + n_B_manual_qc + n_C_reported_raw > 0 | Code %in% unique(c(ler_new_yield$Code, ler_new_manual$Code))]
checklist[, `:=`(qc_status = "", qc_notes = "", qc_by = "", qc_date = "")]
setorder(checklist, -n_A_automatic, Code)
review <- review[Code %in% checklist$Code]

data.table::fwrite(checklist, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_paper_checklist.csv"))
data.table::fwrite(review, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_system_review.csv"))
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "checklist"); openxlsx::writeDataTable(wb, "checklist", checklist)
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "systems");   openxlsx::writeDataTable(wb, "systems", review)
openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "systems", firstRow = TRUE); openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "checklist", firstRow = TRUE)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(qc_dir, "LER_QC_workbook.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)

knitr::kable(checklist[, .(Code, Author, Date, n_A_automatic, n_B_manual_qc, n_C_reported_raw, n_D_unresolved, n_flagged, LER_min, LER_max)])
```
